classification: Post hoc supplementary analysis after external outcomes were known; not prespecified, prospective or confirmatory. This plan was frozen before this script calculated the four comparisons.
purpose: Report all four requested complementary source-expansion contrasts from the already audited participant-level saved metrics. No new selection or EEG computation.
analysis_unit: 85 Dreyer participants; each archived per-subject metric is already an arithmetic mean of three seed-specific metrics. For weaker-class recall, the minimum over the two class recalls was computed within each seed before averaging. No trial/seed pseudo-replication.

contrasts.label: S29 minus S9, BROAD/tail_min_recall, weaker-class recall
S29 minus S9, BROAD/tail_min_recall, balanced accuracy
S60 minus S9, CSP+shrinkage LDA/fixed, weaker-class recall
S60 minus S9, CSP+shrinkage LDA/fixed, balanced accuracy

statistics.difference: 100 × (higher-source participant metric minus lower-source participant metric), in percentage points
statistics.test: Paired, two-sided Student t test on participant differences; df84; null mean difference0
statistics.confidence_interval: 95% pointwise unadjusted t interval for the mean paired participant difference
statistics.multiplicity: Holm step-down adjustment across these four post hoc tests only, reported beside raw p values. Original primary test and original three-secondary-test Holm family remain unchanged.
statistics.effect_descriptives: Mean metric in each source condition; mean paired difference, sample standard deviation, standard error and counts improved/unchanged/declined. Descriptive counts add no hypothesis test.
statistics.nonfinite_or_duplicate_policy: Stop; no imputation, dropping or repairing participant rows
statistics.all_contrasts_policy: All four reported regardless of sign, p value or CI.

identity_checks: Original ZIP and member full SHA-256 match plan
Paired trial_manifest_sha256 values agree across compared source conditions
not_performed: Model fit or checkpoint forward inference
Modification of frozen original results, primary test or original secondary family
execution_policy: One bounded free CPU execution of the saved-metric script; existing Python/SciPy runtime only; no installations.
